# Paperlane: Scan to PDF

> Paperlane is a free iPhone app that scans paper documents into clean, multi-page PDFs using Apple's on-device VisionKit edge detection and perspective correction. Scanning, real multi-page PDF export, a searchable on-device text layer on every scan, and the local library are free forever, with no watermark, no scan limit, and no account. The free version is supported by ads. An optional one-time Paperlane Pro purchase adds text export (.txt and .docx), page merging, JPG/PNG export, PDF compression, markup and signing, password protection, and it removes the ads. Everything runs on-device; nothing is uploaded.

## App
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paperlane-scan-to-pdf/id6780053638): Free, iOS, Productivity.
- [Pricing](https://getpaperlane.vercel.app/pricing.md): Free to scan and export PDFs; Paperlane Pro is a one-time USD 4.99 purchase in the United States (no subscription).
- [FAQ](https://getpaperlane.vercel.app/#faq): Free tier, offline use, watermarks, ads, cost, privacy, and OCR.

## What it does
- Scan to PDF: automatic edge detection and perspective correction (Apple VisionKit).
- Real, multi-page PDFs that open, print, and share anywhere. Never image-only, never watermarked.
- Local, on-device library you own. Documents never leave the iPhone.
- Searchable text layer written into every scan by Apple's on-device Vision framework, free, plus library search across the recognized text.
- Paperlane Pro (one-time): export the recognized text as .txt or .docx, smart rename, combine documents, export JPG/PNG, compress PDFs, markup and sign, save a business card as a contact, password-protect PDFs, and remove ads.

## Privacy
- No servers, no account, no cloud sync. Every scan is processed and stored on-device.
- Works fully offline, including airplane mode.
